Bungalow Residence, Bohalis, Ballaghaderreen, Co. Roscommon, F45 RX40:

A Charming Countryside Home in a Beautiful Setting

Nestled in the peaceful countryside of Bohalis, this beautifully presented bungalow offers the perfect balance of rural tranquillity and everyday convenience while being just 4 km from Ballaghaderreen Town and all its amenities. 

The welcoming village of Brusna, with its national school, church and local pub, is only 1.5 km away, making this an ideal location for families and those seeking a relaxed country lifestyle.

Accommodation:
Presented in excellent condition throughout, the accommodation comprises:
•Tiled Entrance Porch
•Welcoming Entrance Hall with carpet flooring
•Comfortable Sitting Room featuring an attractive fireplace
•Bright Dining Room with dual-aspect windows and feature fireplace
•Fully fitted & tiled Kitchen
•Separate Utility Room
•Three spacious Double Bedrooms, all with lovely laminate flooring, with two benefiting from fitted wardrobes
•Fully tiled Family Bathroom

Every room has been thoughtfully maintained, creating a warm and inviting home ready for immediate occupation.

Exceptional Outdoor Space:
Standing on an impressive c. 1.3-acre corner site, the property enjoys beautifully landscaped gardens that provide a stunning backdrop throughout the seasons. 

Mature trees, colourful shrubs and attractive rockeries combine to create a private and picturesque setting.

A wraparound driveway provides ample parking and easy access around the property, while a purpose-built three-bay garage with adjoining greenhouse lean-to offers outstanding storage, workshop space or potential for a variety of uses.

Key Features:
•Excellent countryside location 
•Just 4 km from Ballaghaderreen Town
•Only 1.5 km from Brusna Village
•Beautifully maintained throughout
•Three spacious double bedrooms
•Two reception rooms with feature fireplaces
•Fully fitted kitchen with separate utility
•Large c. 1.3-acre landscaped corner site
•Wraparound driveway with ample parking
•Three-bay garage with greenhouse lean-to
•Ideal family home in a peaceful yet convenient location

Viewing Highly Recommended:
This superb bungalow presents a rare opportunity to acquire a spacious family home in an idyllic countryside setting while remaining within easy reach of local amenities. Combining generous accommodation, exceptional gardens and excellent outbuildings, this property is guaranteed to impress.

Early viewing is highly recommended and welcomed.
